gloss: stopping; halting; staying in one place

definitions.explanation: The act of stopping and remaining in one place, especially used for vehicles at designated stops or for things that stay in a fixed position.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}で{降|お}ります。
examples.english: I'll get off at the next stop.

examples.japanese: バスが{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}に{近|ちか}づいている。
examples.english: The bus is approaching the stop.

examples.japanese: この{辺|あた}りは{路面|ろめん}{電車|でんしゃ}の{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}が{多|おお}いので{注意|ちゅうい}して{運転|うんてん}してください。
examples.english: Please drive carefully around here since there are many streetcar stops.

notes:
Compound of {停|てい} (halt) + {留|りゅう} (stay/remain). Most commonly encountered in the compound {停留所|ていりゅうじょ} (bus stop/tram stop), which is one of the first words visitors to Japan learn for navigating public transport.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {停留所|ていりゅうじょ}: bus stop; tram stop
- バス{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}: bus stop
- {路面|ろめん}{電車|でんしゃ}{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}: streetcar stop
- {停留|ていりゅう}{時間|じかん}: stopping time; dwell time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {停車|ていしゃ}: stopping (of a vehicle) — specifically about a vehicle stopping temporarily, not the place
- {停止|ていし}: halt; cessation — broader; can mean stopping any activity or process
- {滞留|たいりゅう}: staying; lingering — implies remaining longer than expected
- バス{停|てい}: bus stop (abbreviated form) — casual abbreviation often seen on maps
